written: 2026-10-06 21:50 KST, before any metric of this task was computed. Values come from the order (trial values used as given) or were decided from pre-training data only (patch stores, labels, GT points, prior surfaces, camera poses); no stage-0 training output was read to set them.
order: PHD-MAIN-METRICS-TRIAL-v1 (2026-10-06): try the metrics the user fixed on 10-06 on the stage-0 outputs; widen and fix the evaluation regions for stage 1; no training

parents.discard_payload: phase-payloads/phd/main_prep_discard_rule_v1/PHD-MAIN-PREP-DISCARD-RULE-v1 (read-only, mounted /dr: s02_box prior meshes, s52/box_gt GT points)

constraints.no_training: no training; fork r12, module v6 and the stage-0 outputs are not changed (all mounted read-only)
constraints.execution: Docker only (jointbuildgs:dev for CPU steps, jointbuildgs:geogs-conf-guided-v1 for renders and TSDF), network off, at most three Docker jobs at once, one TSDF job at a time (host memory)
constraints.after_results: a definition or value changed after results is recorded in the report section of changes; the definitions confirmed here are fixed before stage-1 results are seen

regions_ext.why: 4.2: one more region code per patch so that stage 1 reads every comparison region from one file; stage-0 region files stay unchanged
regions_ext.data: pre-training only: the v6 box stage-1 runs (s61/box), their v6 labels (s61/box_gt; B0 sites: gt_clean labels, ULS where gt_clean has none, as the stage-0 regions) and the stage-0 region files (regions/)

codes.0: no GT (stage 0 unchanged: label < 0 or excluded cell)
codes.2: measured agreement (stage 0 unchanged): true agree, support, |MVS - GT| <= tau
codes.3: image wrong (stage-0 code 3 renamed): true agree, support, |MVS - GT| > tau or no MVS value
codes.11: prior wrong: true conflict, support, |MVS - GT| <= tau
codes.12: both wrong: true conflict, support, |MVS - GT| > tau or no MVS value (area only)
codes.13: unmeasured wrong prior, missing: true conflict, state missing (seen but not measured)
codes.14: unmeasured wrong prior, invisible: true conflict, state invisible (no view sees it)

regions_ext.no_mvs_value: a support patch without a finite MVS residual median goes with the 'off' side (3 or 12), as stage-0 code 3 did
regions_ext.mvs_minus_gt: |MVS - GT| = |(-mvs_r_med) - gt_med| (vertical on roof-like, along the outward normal on wall-like patches; the stage-0 region rule)
regions_ext.tables: per site x prior x face kind (roof-like, wall-like): patches, area (m2), GT points owned (rows of gt_owner; B0 sites: the owner file of the patch's label source), tau of the kind
regions_ext.maps: per site the stage-0 map layout (LoD2 roofs, LoD2 walls seen from above, ALS), colours per code
regions_ext.output: regions_ext/regions_ext_<site>_<prior>.npz (code_ext + the stage-0 arrays + gt_points + unseen split), regions_ext/summary.json and .csv, figs/regions_ext_<site>.png

unseen_split.why: the order splits the unseen B173 wall patches into true agreement (wall that still stands) and true conflict (gone old upper wall); 18,720 of the 18,747 unseen patches have no GT label (the ULS nadir GT does not see that wall either; 3 agree, 24 conflict), so a rule from the current roof behind the wall decides it; recorded as a departure from the order
unseen_split.patches: LoD2 wall patches of DEBY_LOD2_4959326 whose state is invisible in the v6 LoD2 box run, inside the evaluation range (stage-0 quick-check definition; 18,747 at B173nb_b10)
unseen_split.rule: current top behind the wall = highest GT point (gt_points of the box) in the strip 0.3-2.0 m behind the patch centre (against the outward normal) and within 0.5 m along the wall, >= 5 points; patch centre z > top + tau_wall -> 'above the current roof' (gone old upper wall, inferred conflict); z < top - tau_wall -> 'below the current roof' (wall expected to stand, inferred agreement; its horizontal position is not verified); otherwise ambiguous; fewer than 5 points -> no top
unseen_split.values_why: 0.3 m keeps wall points out of the strip, 2.0 m reaches the roof edge behind a parapet, 0.5 m along the wall = two patch widths, tau_wall = the label tolerance of the box (0.228 m at B173nb_b10)
unseen_split.pre_count: computed on pre-training data before this config was written (B173nb_b10): above 2,991, below 15,375, ambiguous 381, no top 0; of the 24 true-conflict labels 21 lie below the current roof (wall faces displaced from the LoD2 plane, not gone), so the inferred split and the true labels answer different questions; both are reported
unseen_split.sites: B173nb_b10 and B173_b0 (the sites containing B173)

results.run_mesh: stage0/<run>/post/mesh_tsdf.ply (training-view TSDF, 0.05 m; stage-0 post unchanged)
results.prior_as_is: the registered prior surface itself put in place of the result: LoD2 = s02_box lod2_mesh without the GroundSurface (bottom) triangles (tri_type 2; r9 removed them from the prior), ALS = s02_box als_mesh (the TIN of ALS ground and building points) + the registration shift of the v6 box run (LoD2 0, ALS (-0.056, +0.063, 0))
results.prior_same_path: 4.4 path 4: the prior surface rendered at the 203 training views (camera-Z depth of the first ray hit, the fork's camera model via to_cam_open3d) and fused with the stage-0 TSDF settings (voxel 0.05 m, sdf_trunc 0.25 m, depth_trunc 300 m, the stage-0 box mask) -> one mesh per prior; used as a second 'prior as-is' in every 4.3 metric
results.why: the order: every metric for the four trainings and for the prior as-is (surface and same-path mesh)

gt_points.points: the stage-0 quick-check GT: s52/box_gt/B173nb_b10/gt_points.npz inside the evaluation range (eval_u 115.4-191.0, eval_v 55.0-109.1), excluded cells (any) removed
gt_points.roof_points: inside a LoD2 footprint of the box and not on vertical surfaces (v4 rule)
gt_points.wall_points: on vertical surfaces (v4 rule) and single-return
gt_points.ownership: s61/box_gt/B173nb_b10/gt_owner_<prior>.npz rows (point, patch, value = GT - prior along the line); a roof point counts through rows of roof-like patches, a wall point through rows of wall-like patches
gt_points.region_of_a_row: the extended region code of the row's patch (regions_ext)
gt_points.why: the order: the same GT points, roof / wall rule and excluded cells as the stage-0 check

edge_band.rule: a roof point is in the edge band when the range (max - min) of GT heights within 0.5 m (horizontal) around it exceeds 0.3 m; computed on a 0.1 m raster of the per-cell max and min GT z of all box GT points with a disk filter of radius 5 cells
edge_band.why: order trial values; the 0.1 m raster is the computing approximation of 'within 0.5 m'
edge_band.known_before_results: on a plane steeper than about 17 degrees the height range within 0.5 m already exceeds 0.3 m, so steep roof faces (gables, sawtooth faces) fall in the band; kept as the trial value, the excluded share is reported by roof slope for 4.7

line.roof_like: vertical line through the GT point (+z)
line.wall_like: line through the GT point along the outward normal of the owning LoD2 wall face

wrong_data.prior_wrong_and_unmeasured: W = the registered prior surface: offset of W from the GT point along the line s_W = -value
wrong_data.image_wrong: W = the patch's MVS surface = prior + (-mvs_r_med) along the line: s_W = -value + (-mvs_r_med)

spread.near: a surface is near the GT point (near W) when the result mesh crosses the line within +-t of the GT point (of W); t = min(0.5 m, |s_W| / 2)
spread.spread_share: (wrong_side + both) / all points of the region
spread.ambiguous: points with |s_W| < 0.2 m: share recorded; spread shares reported over all points and over the points with |s_W| >= 0.2 m
spread.mechanism_layer: per patch of the region: is a prior-origin Gaussian with opacity >= 0.5 of the final dump within 0.25 m of the patch's W centre (prior wrong: the moved patch centre; image wrong: the centre moved by -mvs_r_med along the line); share of patches; image wrong additionally with Gaussians of any origin (record: Gaussians following a wrong image need not come from the prior)
spread.invisible_patches: no training view sees them, so the training-view mesh cannot hold them: their spread is given by the mechanism layer and the virtual-view mesh (4.5) only

size_curve.below_one: points of prior-wrong patches whose own |s_W| < tau are reported as a separate bin '< 1' (the region is decided per patch, the bin per point)
size_curve.variable: per point |s_W| / tau of the owning patch's kind (LoD2: roof 0.176 m, wall 0.228 m; ALS 0.147 m at B173nb_b10)
size_curve.curve: share of 'GT side' per bin, both seeds per prior; vertical lines at tau, at the conflict threshold (LoD2 1 tau: rule current; ALS 2 tau: rule margin_all_2) and at the truncation 4 tau
size_curve.representative_sections: per prior and bin: the prior-wrong patch whose |gt_med| / tau lies in the bin and that owns the most GT points; vertical section through its centre, 12 m long, along the horizontal direction of the face's dip (u axis when the face is flat within 5 degrees), GT points within 0.25 m of the plane; chosen from pre-training data before the metrics (written to defs/sections.json)
size_curve.why: order bins; section choice decided here (the order left it open)

accuracy.roof: roof points owned by roof-like patches, edge band removed (share removed recorded): z_result - z_GT with z_result = the highest crossing of the result mesh with the vertical line (stage 0); signed median, NMAD (1.4826 MAD), median |dz|, 68.3 % and 95 % quantiles of |dz|
accuracy.edge_band_and_walls: signed distance along the normal of the owning patch's prior face (roof-like: up-oriented patch normal; wall-like: outward wall normal) to the nearest crossing of the result mesh within +-2 m; median and NMAD; no crossing within 2 m counted
accuracy.results: the four trainings, the prior surface as-is and the same-path prior mesh, side by side
accuracy.why: the order; 2 m search = beyond the largest tolerance multiple used (4 tau < 1 m) with room for a misplaced surface

completeness.rule: unsigned 3-D distance from each owned GT point to the result mesh: shares <= 0.2 m and <= 0.5 m
completeness.unseen: B173 unseen wall patches (unseen_split): share of patch centres with a prior-origin Gaussian of opacity >= 0.5 within 0.25 m (stage-0 count), split by the inferred label: below the current roof = inheritance share, above = wrongly remaining share; the 27 labelled patches reported by their true label; also the share of patch centres within 0.2 / 0.5 m of the training-view mesh and of the virtual-view mesh (4.5)

floaters.gaussians: Gaussians of the final dump with opacity >= 0.5 whose centre lies inside the evaluation range and more than 3 m above the highest GT surface there
floaters.highest_gt_surface: per 1 m cell: max GT z (all box GT points, excluded cells included: trees are real surfaces), then a 3 x 3 cell maximum; a cell without GT in its 3 x 3 neighbourhood uses the highest GT point of the evaluation range
floaters.pixels: evaluation views (29): a pixel counts when the render with all Gaussians has accumulated opacity >= 0.5 and the render without the floater Gaussians has accumulated opacity < 0.5 or an expected depth more than 0.5 m larger; share of all pixels of the 29 views
floaters.why: order trial value 3 m; 1 m cells with a 3 x 3 maximum keep wall tops and tree crowns from making false floaters; 'the depth comes from those Gaussians' is decided by removing them and rendering again

summary_numbers.building_surface: 0.5 m cells of the survey grid that lie within 2 m of a LoD2 GroundSurface footprint of the box, inside the evaluation range, not excluded and holding at least one GT point; GT points = the GT points in these cells; result points = area-weighted random samples of the result mesh triangles whose centroid lies in these cells, 400 per m2 (one per 0.05 m x 0.05 m), seed 0
summary_numbers.chamfer: mean nearest-neighbour distance result -> GT, GT -> result, and their mean
summary_numbers.precision_completeness_f1: precision = share of result points within t of a GT point, completeness = share of GT points within t of a result point, F1 = harmonic mean; t = 0.2 m and 0.5 m

m3c2.core_points: GT points of the building surface, one per 0.5 m voxel (the point nearest the voxel centre)
m3c2.clouds: reference = GT points, compared = result points, both thinned to one point per 0.05 m voxel
m3c2.normal_orientation: PCA normal of the GT points within 0.5 m (>= 10 points); |n_z| >= 0.5 oriented up, otherwise oriented with the outward normal of the nearest LoD2 wall triangle
m3c2.distance: mean position of the compared points in the cylinder minus that of the reference points, along the normal; at least 5 points of each cloud; else no distance (share reported)
m3c2.summary: signed median and NMAD over the core points with a distance
m3c2.why: Lague et al. 2013: normal scale >= 20 x roughness and >= ~30 points in the projection cylinder (GT ~1,000 points / m2 -> ~200 in a 0.5 m cylinder); max depth 1 m = above the largest tolerance multiple of interest

summary_numbers.why: the order: records for comparison with other studies, not used for the research questions

seed_spread: every number of 4.3 and 4.4: seed 1 (batch 2) minus seed 0 (batch 1), per prior
timing: per metric bundle and result: seconds (wall, inside the container), to estimate the stage-1 post time

bias_paths.points: the 4.3 roof accuracy points (measured agreement, roof-like, edge band removed) of each prior; also on the points common to both priors

paths.1: result TSDF mesh: highest crossing of the vertical line (stage 0)
paths.2: result render depth of the 29 evaluation views (stage-0 post/eval, expected depth, accumulated opacity >= 0.5) back-projected to 3-D points with the fork's camera model; z = median of the points in the GT point's 0.1 m cell (>= 3 points)
paths.3: prior surface as-is: highest crossing of the vertical line
paths.4: same-path prior mesh: highest crossing of the vertical line
paths.5: MVS of the training images: COLMAP geometric depth (confidence 1 = valid geometric depth, the r10 confidence mask) of the 203 box training views back-projected with the stage-1 camera convention; z = median of the points in the GT point's 0.1 m cell (>= 3 points)

bias_paths.summary: signed median and NMAD of z_path - z_GT on the same points (the points with a value on every path in the common table)
bias_paths.reading: 1 - 2 = the mesh-making part; 4 - 3 = what the same path adds to a known surface; 3 vs 5 = the height fit of GT and the two data
bias_paths.why: the order; the 0.1 m cell median is the decided way to read a height from a point cloud at a GT point

virtual_view_mesh.method: r10 (mesh_r10.py product layer): TSDF of the rendered expected depth of the training views plus virtual views made by the fork's create_virtual_cameras_for_completion, whole scene, the stage-0 box mask
virtual_view_mesh.aim: the B173 unseen wall patches (unseen_split.patches) instead of r10's invisible Gaussians, so that all four runs use the same 16 views
virtual_view_mesh.rings: two rings of 8 at elevations 0.2 and 0.5 (z offset = elevation x distance), azimuths 0, 45, ..., 315 degrees from +x, looking at the centre (r10 / base helper values)
virtual_view_mesh.distance_rule: 1.5 x 2 x radius (base helper, distance_scale 1.5); radius = largest distance of an unseen patch centre from their mean
virtual_view_mesh.intrinsics: of the first training view (base helper)
virtual_view_mesh.front_of_main_wall: 8 of the 16 views lie in front of the main unseen wall (ext 53, outward normal (0.93, -0.37, 0)): azimuths 0 and 315 (cos 0.92-0.93) and 45 and 270 (cos 0.37-0.40) in both rings
virtual_view_mesh.fallback: host out-of-memory -> voxel 0.10 m, sdf_trunc 0.5 m (r10), recorded
virtual_view_mesh.mechanism_layer: not built: r10's second layer needs an 'aimed Gaussians' set; the Gaussian count of 4.3 plays that part
virtual_view_mesh.per_view_record: unseen patch centres inside the view and in front of the rendered depth by at most 0.5 m (seen) per virtual view
virtual_view_mesh.measures: below-the-roof side: owned GT points (359 points) within 0.2 / 0.5 m (3-D) and the GT cover there (share of patches with an owned GT point, with a label), share of patch centres within 0.2 / 0.5 m; above-the-roof side: share of patch centres within 0.2 / 0.5 m (the gone wall left in the mesh); mesh vertices within 0.2 m (in the wall plane) of an unseen patch centre and within 2 m of the wall: signed distance to the LoD2 wall plane (quantiles, histogram); time and host memory
virtual_view_mesh.why: the order: r10's method, views fixed before computing, 0.05 m unless memory runs out

figures.spread_map: plan view of B173 and neighbours, GT points of the spread regions coloured by class, the four trainings and both prior-as-is
figures.size_curve: per prior, both seeds; vertical lines tau, conflict threshold, 4 tau; one representative section per bin (sections.json)
figures.height_map: z_result - z_GT of the accuracy roof points, common colour range +-0.5 m, edge band grey; the four trainings and the prior as-is
figures.bias_paths: signed median bars and NMAD of the five paths
figures.unseen: the virtual-view mesh at the main wall and the Gaussians there coloured by origin
figures.floaters: side view of the Gaussians (opacity >= 0.5), floaters highlighted
figures.reading: every figure with a 1-2 sentence 'how to read'

repetition_input.rule: per metric: seed spread |seed 1 - seed 0| next to the difference between the method and the prior as-is at the same place (|training mean - prior-as-is surface|), and the ratio spread / difference; a small ratio means one run per condition can separate them

stop.other_errors: stop at the error and ask
stop.time: estimates per task in progress.md at the start; stop and ask when the whole task looks like exceeding twice the estimate
